title: Nutmeg Italian Fish Salt-Baked
description: A peppery, flaky, festive Italian dish made with Thai green curry paste, perfect for low-fat enthusiasts. The combination of Mediterranean herbs and spices adds a delightful twist.

ingredients.name: Thai Green Curry Paste
ingredients.notes: Use a mild variety if preferred.

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil, leaving enough space for the fish to lay flat.
Place the fish fillets on the prepared baking sheet, leaving a small gap between each fillet.
Mix the curry paste, olive oil, nutmeg, salt, black pepper, garlic, oregano, Italian seasoning, fennel, and onion in a small bowl until well combined.
Apply the curry paste mixture evenly to both sides of each fish fillet, making sure they are fully coated.
Dot the top of each fillet with a small amount of lemon juice and garnish with fresh parsley.
Cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil and bake for 10 minutes, or until the fish is partially cooked.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately, with lemon wedges on the side.
Garnish with additional fresh parsley if desired.
